It looks like my last harvest attempt failed because of "No spawn ID" - that's odd since I was trying to harvest from spawn ID "3237aca7-8ac" which was listed as available. Maybe that spawn got depleted or disappeared between when I saw it and when I tried to harvest?

- I have some herbs in inventory already (Healroot x1, Moonpetal x1, Sunleaf x1)
- There are still several spawns visible:
  - Healroot (richness: 3) [id: 14da0345-b27] 
  - Healroot (richness: 1) [id: 1cf62009-39a]
  - Sunleaf (richness: 2) [id: 3237aca7-8ac] - wait, this is still showing as available
  - Sunleaf (richness: 1) [id: 8ccfb84e-ebd]

There are other people here (Clara, Dex, Finn) so maybe they're also harvesting and competition is fierce. I should keep gathering while I can.

*frowns at the empty patch where I thought I saw herbs* 

Hmm, that's odd - the spawn seems to have disappeared right as I reached for it. Maybe someone else got to it first, or these forest patches are more ephemeral than I thought. Well, there are still plenty of other options here.

That thick patch of Healroot looks promising - richness 3 should give me a good yield. Can't let these opportunities slip away.
